text: It was once well said. <break time="0.8s" /> Of a certain German book. <break time="0.8s" /> That it does not permit itself. <break time="0.8s" /> To be read. <break time="0.8s" /> And in the same way. <break time="0.8s" /> There are some secrets. <break time="0.8s" /> Which do not permit themselves. <break time="0.8s" /> To be told. <break time="0.8s" /> Many a man dies quietly in his bed. <break time="0.8s" /> With a secret still locked in his heart. <break time="0.8s" /> Unable to reveal the very mystery. <break time="0.8s" /> That has haunted his conscience for years. <break time="0.8s" /> Not long ago, one autumn evening. <break time="0.8s" /> I sat at the large bow window. <break time="0.8s" /> Of a coffee house in London. <break time="0.8s" /> For I had been ill. <break time="0.8s" /> For several months. <break time="0.8s" /> And was only now recovering my strength. <break time="0.8s" /> Freed at last from the dull fog of illness. <break time="0.8s" /> I was in one of those rare moods. <break time="0.8s" /> Of heightened keenness. <break time="0.8s" /> When the film seems to fall. <break time="0.8s" /> From the minds eye. <break time="0.8s" /> And every trifle offers calm delight. <break time="0.8s" /> For some time I amused myself. <break time="0.8s" /> By reading the advertisements in a newspaper. <break time="0.8s" /> But at length. <break time="0.8s" /> My attention was drawn. <break time="0.8s" /> To the street outside. <break time="0.8s" /> Which was one of the principal thoroughfares. <break time="0.8s" /> Of the city. <break time="0.8s" /> As darkness came on the throng thickened every moment. <break time="0.8s" /> And by the time the lamps were lit. <break time="0.8s" /> Two dense and continuous tides of people. <break time="0.8s" /> Were rushing past the door. <break time="0.8s" /> I had never before been in a similar situation at such an hour. <break time="0.8s" /> And the tumultuous sea of human heads. <break time="0.8s" /> Filled me with a delicious novelty of emotion. <break time="0.8s" /> At first my observations took an abstract and general turn. <break time="0.8s" /> But soon I descended to details. <break time="0.8s" /> Regarding with minute interest. <break time="0.8s" /> The innumerable varieties. <break time="0.8s" /> Of figure, dress, air, gait, and expression.
